components.name: Filled button
components.description: Case-study, resume, and error action. Ink fill, paper text, pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Secondary case-study action. Transparent pill with an inset ink stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text link
components.description: Home contact, socials, and inline references. Underlined type, not a capsule.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; background-image: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding-bottom: 1px; transition: background-size 220ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-link:hover { background-size: 0 1px; background-position: 100% 100%; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter
components.description: Work-index type filter. Hairline pill at rest, ink fill when pressed.
components.css: .ds-filters { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-filter { height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-2); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-rule); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms var(--ease-out), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: none; } .ds-filter:hover:not([aria-pressed='true']) { color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-ink); } .ds-filter:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search control
components.description: Header trigger for the command palette. Plate ground, 8px corners.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-plate); color: var(--color-ink-2); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.8125rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search kbd { font: inherit; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-search:hover { background: var(--color-rule); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; height: 3.75rem; background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-rule); font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-wordmark { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-nav a { padding: 0.5rem 0.125rem; color: var(--color-ink-2); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'], .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-lamp { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-signal); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-signal) 22%, transparent); }

components.name: Command palette
components.description: Instant search panel. Transparent field, ink selected row.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-palette { width: min(36rem, 100%); background: var(--color-paper); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 0 0 1px var(--color-rule); font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-palette-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-rule); } .ds-palette-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-palette-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-palette-label { padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.375rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-palette-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; margin: 0 0.5rem 0.25rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-palette-item span:last-child { opacity: 0.6; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-palette-item[data-selected='true'] { background: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-paper); }

components.name: Spec table
components.description: Ruled facts for a model. Ink top rule, hairline rows, mid-grey keys.
components.css: .ds-spec { margin: 0; display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-spec > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(6rem, 9rem) 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.625rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-spec dt { color: var(--color-ink-2); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-spec dd { margin: 0; }

components.name: Catalogue plate
components.description: 16/10 product well. Portrait screens share it, up to three across.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem; background: var(--color-plate); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-plate span { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; height: 100%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink) 14%, var(--color-plate)); }

components.name: Rotary dial
components.description: Signature selector. Plate knob, signal pointer, ticks, and the model index.
components.html: M-01ModelM-02Model
components.css: .ds-dial-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-dial { width: 8.5rem; filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)); } .ds-dial svg { width: 100%; height: auto; overflow: visible; display: block; } .ds-index { display: grid; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule); } .ds-index a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.25rem 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule); font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink-2); text-decoration: none; } .ds-index a[aria-current='true'] { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-index a span:first-child { font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-index i { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; } .ds-index a[aria-current='true'] i { background: var(--color-signal); } .ds-index a:hover { color: var(--color-ink); }

narrative.overview:
A product catalogue for one engineer. Each project is a numbered model with a spec table, in the manner of Braun literature: calm, exact, and trustworthy. The ground is matte warm-grey plastic, the type is a single neutral grotesque, and a rotary dial with tick marks is the recurring object.

Density stays quiet. The home page is a sticky intro beside catalogue sheets, and those sheets rest at full opacity. The name and role share one tracked uppercase line above the display headline. Section titles on the home page stand alone. Motion is the dial, a one-time load on the intro column, and the case-study carousel.
keyCharacteristics: Matte warm-grey ground, plate-colored image wells, and near-black ink
One signal orange, used for selection and status
Hanken Grotesk as the only screen face, with tracked uppercase labels
The name and role locked on the label line above the home headline
Model numbers (M-01) and spec tables with ruled rows
One 16/10 plate for every product, portrait screens up to three across
Underlined contact links on the home page, and filled and ghost capsules on case studies

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal orange marks selection and status: the dial's active tick and pointer, the current model dot, the availability lamp, the text caret, the work-index number on hover, and the pointer on a plate with no photograph. It is not a fill for buttons, plates, or sections.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Hanken Grotesk is the only screen face. Size, weight, and tracking make the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Name Line Rule
rules.body: On the home page the name and role share one label line, joined by a middle dot, directly above the display headline. The line is the label style: 0.75rem, weight 500, 0.08em tracking, uppercase, mid-grey.

rules.name: The Catalogue Column Rule
rules.body: From 52rem the home page is a 34/66 split. The intro is sticky and centered under the header. Catalogue sheets occupy the wide column.

rules.name: The Shared Plate Rule
rules.body: Landscape and portrait product shots share one 16/10 plate. Portrait screens sit side by side inside it, up to three across.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with a 1px rule. Spec tables and revision lists open on an ink rule and continue on hairline rows. Sheets, rows, and the header stay flat.

rules.name: The Still Sheet Rule
rules.body: Catalogue sheets and the home sections below them are present at full opacity. The intro column is the only place that runs an entrance animation.

rules.name: The Two Silhouettes Rule
rules.body: Plates are softly squared at 6px. Button actions are pills. Home contact actions are underlined words, with no capsule around them.

rules.name: The Split Control Rule
rules.body: Home contact controls are underlined type links. Case-study pages use the filled capsule and the ghost capsule. Each stays on its own page.

dos: Do keep the page on the matte ground, images in plate wells, and text in near-black ink.
Do leave signal orange for selection and status, as the Signal Rule states.
Do set the home name and role in the tracked uppercase label line above the display headline.
Do number models M-01 and place facts in ruled spec rows.
Do put every product screen in the 16/10 plate, with portrait shots side by side, up to three.
Do run the load sequence once, on the intro column only, and let sheets rest at full opacity.
Do use underlined links for home contact, and the filled and ghost capsules on case studies.
Do keep Contact in the header at 390px, and hide Experience under 40rem.
donts: Don't lay projects out as a card grid.
Don't open the page with a dark hero. The scheme is light.
Don't use signal orange as a button fill or a section background.
Don't fade or slide catalogue sheets in as they enter the viewport.
Don't put capsule buttons on the home contact actions.
Don't drop Contact from the header at narrow widths.
Don't list a project on the home catalogue without a cover photograph.
